messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear TM Partners Team,

Your exclusive focus on executive search and leadership advisory across the global mining and resources sector makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where mining strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and coordinated execution across corporate, technical and public-sector stakeholders. Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC are priority markets, while I remain internationally mobile for suitable global appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for current or future mandates across mining, ESG, external affairs, government relations, stakeholder leadership and country operations.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
